Title: General availability: Azure Site Recovery now supports failover of multiple IP configurations

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports the failover of your secondary IP configurations for your Azure VMs. With this release, you can configure the failover and test failover settings for each secondary IP configuration.

Also, the network configuration experience has been enhanced. You now have two separate blades for Compute and Network.

Note: This feature is currently supported only in A2A scenario.

Configuring multiple IP addresses

Navigate to the Disaster Recovery blade of your protected Azure VM and select Network in the left pane to view the revamped Network page.

In addition to the existing network configurations, you can configure the failover and test failover settings of your secondary IP configurations using the Failover and Test failover UI options.

Learn more.
